results.derivationAndAnswers: Part a: tangent y=e^(ab)+ae^(ab)(x−b), so T=(b−1/a,0). For a line through (p,0) with two intersections its slope m is positive: m≤0 makes m(x−p)−e^(ax) strictly decreasing, so at most one intersection. For m>0 intersections have x>p and m=e^(ax)/(x−p). This ratio decreases until x=p+1/a and increases thereafter, with minimum ae^(ap+1); two distinct intersections require strict m>ae^(ap+1). The supplied worked solution asserts the critical comparison after convexity but does not establish it.
